02Contact

Minifig HuntCollectible Minifigures

About

One collector.
Every figure.

Minifig Hunt started as a list I kept for myself: which series came out when, which figure was in which bag, which ones I still needed.

It grew into this site, every Collectible Minifigures series since 2010, each figure shown on its own, with a way to mark what you own and what you are still hunting.

It is free, it has no ads, and it is built and kept up to date by one person in the evenings.

Happy hunting.

Support the site

Hosting, the domain and the hours spent adding each new wave are paid out of my own pocket. If Minifig Hunt saved you a trip or a duplicate, a coffee helps keep it free for everyone.
